answer: Social Matters >> Nikah (Marriage) Question ID: 22858 Country: India Title: I would like to know about the marriage related aspect. Is a person allowed to marry his Father's Eldest Sister's (Puppu) Eldest Son's (In relation my brother) Daughter. If not then what I have to do now because I got married and having two children. Waiting for your reply. Question: I would like to know about the marriage related aspect. Is a person allowed to marry his Father's Eldest Sister's (Puppu) Eldest Son's (In relation my brother) Daughter. If not then what I have to do now because I got married and having two children. Waiting for your reply. Answer ID: 22858 Posted on: Sep 1, 2020 Bismillah hir-Rahman nir-Rahim ! (Fatwa: 1067/867/B=1431) Yes it is right to marry the daughter of father's sister (phoophi) and also with the daughter of phoophi's son as well. و احل لكم ما وراء ذلكم. Allah (Subhana Wa Ta'ala) knows Best Darul Ifta, Darul Uloom Deoband, India
